summary: Prevents staging infrastructure work from overwriting release-owned provisioning, readiness and heartbeat configuration.
userImpact: Staging delivery guidance now distinguishes first-bootstrap metadata from release-owned serving configuration.
Future staging troubleshooting fails closed on API/worker disagreement and retains incident locks until tenant routing is restored.

instructions: Reinstall version 0.1.12 of the EnterpriseGlue development-workflows plugin after merging this change.

security: The guidance requires exact serving configuration, incident-bound evidence and generation-conditional retained-lock recovery.
documentation: Updates the staging-delivery skill and maintained workflow-plugin guide.
knownLimitations: Executable staging recovery identities remain fixed in the independently maintained EnterpriseGlue Cloud repository.
rollback: Revert the plugin guidance and version bump; this does not alter deployed Cloud resources.
validation: Run the bundled plugin tests, official Codex skill and plugin validators, documentation-boundary guard, and release-note validation.
